command: mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway05.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user YngfJMu2WmuzoDE.ecba372003d8 --database Duqshn4D3kdv9jkbtBdj4X --execute SELECT id, state_code, dem_candidate, rep_candidate, status, notes, rep_bio, dem_bio, rep_previous_office, dem_previous_office FROM governor_races WHERE state_code IN ('TX', 'GA') ORDER BY state_code;

rows.notes: R primary runoff (July 2026): Burt Jones (Lt. Governor, Trump-endorsed) vs. Rick Jackson. Winner faces Keisha Lance Bottoms (D) in November.
rows.dem_bio: Former Mayor of Atlanta (2018–2022) and senior adviser to President Biden. Previously a member of the Atlanta City Council. Democratic primary also includes Geoff Duncan (former Lt. Governor), Jason Esteves, and Michael Thurmond.

rows.rep_bio: The 48th Governor of Texas, serving since 2015. Former Texas Attorney General (1999–2015). Seeking a fourth term in a solidly Republican state.
rows.dem_bio: Current member of the Texas House of Representatives, serving since 2017. Attorney and advocate for Texas families. Won the Democratic primary as the sole major Democratic candidate.
